basis: Explicit vision, burden, woe, date, messenger, vocative, addressee, prose-scene, sign, song, prayer, invitation and closure signals. Canonical relations are evidence only and never dictate a seam, harmonize Kings, identify a child/king/servant, select a witness, establish fulfillment, or authorize theology, authorship, strata or dating.
proposal_bias: Prefer the larger complete oracle, poem, sign narrative, disputation, prose scene or liturgical movement. Preserve exact macro parents and narrower alternatives wherever the internal seam remains contestable.

chunks.risk: Authorship, strata and chronology smuggling.
chunks.hold: Keep relation to the whole anthology structural only; external historical-form review may revisit heading scope.

chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not split at chapter, identify Rahab mythically as doctrine, or let later herald citation dictate seam.
chunks.risk: Chapter fallback, mythic identification and canonical reuse.
chunks.hold: Cross-chapter awake sequence retained; exact movements preserved.

chunks.form: behold-servant exaltation/suffering poem

chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not split at chapter, select textual readings, identify servant, or let New Testament reuse impose subunits.
chunks.risk: Christological/messianic fulfillment, servant identity, translation/variant and atonement theology.

chunks.risk: Ecclesial/national identity and covenant theology.
chunks.hold: Whole restoration oracle retained; reception deferred.

chunks.risk: Devotional prooftexting, covenant/messianic fulfillment and theology.
chunks.hold: Complete invitation-to-new-exodus finale retained.

chunks.form: justice summons and inclusion/gathering oracle
